description: Native one-bucket scale-up: train a scratch 1-input-bucket Enyo net on Stockfish binpack through Bullet after the 1-bucket smoke was the least-bad broad-gate native result. This tests whether the no-bucket direction scales before trying 2/4 buckets or new data. It is checkpoint-gated, not a promotion candidate.

metadata.hypothesis: The 1-input-bucket smoke beat the longer 32-bucket native checkpoint on the 800-target gate despite much less training. A longer one-bucket SF-binpack run may show whether bucket starvation, not only data volume, is blocking native scratch.

validation.checkpoint_gate: sweep checkpoints 1024,2048,4096,8192 against cached 800-target broad/search gates before any SPRT
validation.stop_condition: reject if the 800-target gate does not improve materially over the 1-bucket smoke or retains non-mate -32000cp tails
validation.promotion: not eligible for SPRT without passing checkpoint search gates and failure replay
